tiers.name: Supporter
tiers.description: Support the development of an indie project.
perks: Plotlyst Roadmap Form: Influence the roadmap and future releases
Guaranteed Support: Receive help and answers to your questions
Recognition in Plotlyst: Your name listed inside the app, with an optional link to your website

tiers.name: Plotlyst Plus Member
tiers.description:
Unlock all Plotlyst Plus extensions.

Gain access to the Plotlyst Roadmap Form, an online form where you can share your preferences and become an integral part of Plotlyst’s roadmap. Your answers will help shape the future direction of Plotlyst and influence upcoming releases.
perks: Plotlyst Plus Access: Unlock all future premium Plotlyst Plus features (currently under development)

tiers.name: Early Access Patron
tiers.description: Experience new features before anyone else.
perks: Early access to new features and updates
Optional Feedback Opportunity: Share your thoughts to help refine new features
Acknowledgment in Release Notes for tested features

tiers.name: VIP Patron
tiers.description: Stand out with exclusive recognition and enjoy top-priority support.
perks: Premium Recognition: Prominent listing in the app with a description, avatar, and socials
Priority Support: Get faster responses to inquiries
Direct chat on Discord with the developer
